Of all the ancient Fundamentals, he is the oldest and most tireless, endlessly searching out a being he knows only as "The Light." Long ago the Light ventured out from the progenitor realm, in defiance of the first covenant. Now Chaos Knight shifts from plane to plane, always on the hunt to extinguish the Light wherever he finds it. A thousand times he has snuffed out the source, and always he slides into another plane to continue his search anew.

Upon his steed Armageddon he rides, wading into battle with maniacal frenzy, drawing strength from the disorder of the universe. A physical manifestation of chaos itself, in times of need he calls upon other versions of himself from other planes, and together these dark horsemen ride into battle, as unstoppable as any force of nature. Only when the last Light of the world is scoured from existence will the search be ended. The phantasms are illusions that deal 60% damage, but take 350% damage. }} * The {{M|illusion}} spawn distance is defined as: ** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|Caster[[Collision Size|ColSize]] × (NumberOf[[Illusions]] + 2)}} ** For Chaos Knight, the illusion spawn distance is {{calc|{{G|collision size hero}}*(v1+2)|v1=1/2/3}}/{{ValueColor||{{calc|{{G|collision size hero}}*(v1+2)|v1=4}}|agh}} per level. }} ==Recent Matches== {{Main|Chaos Knight/Matches}} {{Hero matches table|hero=Chaos Knight|limit=5|vod=false|stats=false}} ==={{Symbol|TI}} [[The International]]=== {{TI Winning | win1 = 2013 | win2 = 2023}} ==Recent Changes== {{Main|Chaos Knight/Changelogs|Chaos Knight/Old Abilities|Chaos Knight/Lore|l1=Changelogs|l2=Old Abilities|l3=Hero Lore}} {{Recent changes wrapper}} ==Dota Plus Progress== {{Main|Chaos Knight/Relics#Challenges|l1=Hero Challenges}} {{#lst:Chaos Knight/Relics|Table}} ==Equipment== {{Equipment Chaos Knight}} ==Trivia== * {{A|Chaos Knight|Chaos Strike}}'s ability icon bears a similar appearance to a D20 dice, commonly used in table-top RPG games, where a full 20 usually results in a critical. * Chaos Knight's lore and responses draw many references to the [[wikipedia:Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse|Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse]], and his ultimate is a literalisation of it. * vo_chaos_knight_chaknight_ally_03.mp3 "Ah, Tidehunter, can I offer you a seabiscuit?" is a reference to [[wikipedia:Seabiscuit|Seabiscuit]], a famous American racehorse. * Fitting his theme of randomness, Chaos Knight has the most varying attack damage in the game, with a difference of {{#expr:{{show|H|Chaos Knight|atkmax}}-{{show|H|Chaos Knight|atkmin}}}} between his mininum and maximum attack damage. * Chaos Knight's name in DotA was "Nessaj". This was removed in his transition to Dota 2, likely due to the change in his background story. * {{H|Enigma}}, Chaos Knight, {{H|Keeper of the Light}}, and {{H|Io}} together represent the four [[wikipedia:fundamental interaction|fundamental forces]] of the universe with Chaos Knight representing the [[wikipedia:strong interaction|strong interaction]], the force that binds quarks to make protons and neutrons. It is also one of the forces present in the detonation of a nuclear bomb, a weapon commonly seen as a tool of widespread death and destruction. ** Fitting to his theme, the strong force is the most powerful among the four fundamental forces, but its strength is very limited in far distances. Hence his status as a melee strength hero whose role is that of a hard carry. Furthermore, his Reality Rift spell brings an enemy hero into Chaos Knight's effective melee range, just like how the strong force binds quarks together with its strength. ** The [[wikipedia:uncertainty principle|uncertainty principle]] determines the range of the strong nuclear force. This is the reason why Chaos Knight's abilities and damage are so random. *** Furthermore, {{H|Enigma}} references the uncertainty principle when killing {{H|Chaos Knight}}: vo_enigma_enig_rival_11.mp3 "Chaos Knight: so limited by uncertainty." * Chaos Knight's default mount's name is [[Armageddon]]. * One of Chaos Knight's death responses, vo_chaos_knight_chaknight_death_10.mp3 "Armageddon…out of here." may be a reference drawn from the film "Bruce Almighty" where, towards the end of the film the doomsayer (homeless man with handwritten signboard, often with typos) holds a sign "ARMAGEDON OUTA HERE". It works as a cheeky wordplay on "I'mma gettin' out of here"; reflecting on something that doesn't quite cease to be amazing, even while calling for a closure. * Upon killing {{H|Dragon Knight}}, vo_chaos_knight_chaknight_rival_11.mp3 "You did need a steed, didn't you?", answers to one of his lines when he moves: vo_dragon_knight_drag_move_06.mp3 "I need no steed". * {{wc3}} similarities: ** In DotA, Chaos Knight uses the model of the Orc Warchief, a campaign-only {{wc3|Orc}} unit. ** {{A|Chaos Knight|Chaos Bolt}}'s original iteration is based on {{wc3|Firebolt}}. ** {{A|Chaos Knight|Chaos Strike}}'s original iteration is identical to the {{wc3|Blademaster}}'s {{wc3|Blademaster|Critical Strike}}. ** {{A|Chaos Knight|Phantasm}}'s original iteration is identical to the {{wc3|Blademaster}}'s {{wc3|Blademaster|Mirror Image}}. ==Gallery== Chaos knight wallpaper.jpg|Splash artwork Chaos Knight Concept Art1.jpg|[[Concept art]] Chaos Knight Concept Art2.jpg|Concept art Chaos Knight ability icon progress.png|Ability icon progress Chaos Knight hero icon progress.png|Hero icon progress T-shirt design Chaos Knight.jpg|Chaos Knight T-shirt design The One True King Bone Harvest Chaos Knight.png|[[Bone Harvest]] sprite - alive The One True King Bone Harvest Chaos Knight dead.png|Bone Harvest sprite - dead Dota 2 Monster Hunter codex chaos knight gameasset.png|[[Dota 2 X Monster Hunter/Hero Atlas#Chaos_Knight|Monster Hunter Hero Atlas Illustration]] Dark Carnival Tarot Cards 09 dota2 gameasset.png|Tarot card from the [[Dark Carnival#The Oracle|Dark Carnival]] event, Death
